mails.name: @family.
mails.subject: Confirm your @family. account
mails.body:
Hello Kit,

Confirm your email address by opening this link:

https://halexdias31-pixel.github.io/family/?verify=TOKEN1

You can already sign in with this email address (or @kit) and the PIN you chose — the link only confirms the address is yours. Until it is opened we send nothing else to this address.

If you did not make this account, do not open the link: use "Forgotten your PIN?" with this address instead — it takes the account over and signs everyone else out.

— @family.

mails.name: @family.
mails.subject: Your @family. account
mails.body:
Hello Kit,

An account has been made for you on @family..

Sign in at {site} with your email (or your handle, @kit) and the PIN 4321

mails.name: @family.
mails.subject: Confirm your new @family. email address
mails.body:
Hello,

Somebody signed in to an @family. account has asked to use this email address for it.

If that was you, open this link on a phone or computer where you are signed in to that account:

https://halexdias31-pixel.github.io/family/?verify=MOVEKEY

Until it is opened, the account keeps its old address — sign in with that, or with your handle. The link works for 3 days.

If it was not you, ignore this email. Nothing changes, and the link does nothing for anybody who is not signed in to that account.

— @family.

mails.name: @family.
mails.subject: For Cara (@cara): Finn has made an @family. account
mails.body:
This email was meant for Cara (@cara), at cara@x.test. Parents get no email from the site for now, so please pass it on.

Hello,

Finn has made an account on @family. and gave this address as their grown-up's, because they have no email of their own.

Their account works already. If that is right, open this link to confirm your address (it also puts them on your @family. parent account if you have one and have confirmed it):

https://halexdias31-pixel.github.io/family/?verify=KIDTOK

They sign in with their handle, @finn, and the PIN they chose. Once you have opened the link, "Forgotten your PIN?" sends a new one to this address if they forget it.

If you have an @family. parent account on this address and have confirmed it, opening the link also puts Finn on it. If you do not know who this is, ignore this email and nothing happens.

— @family.

mails.name: @family.
mails.subject: Your new @family. PIN
mails.body:
Somebody asked for a new PIN on your @family. account, by your handle (@kit).

Your new PIN is 1111

Sign in with your handle, @kit, or your email and this PIN. It works for a day; your old PIN keeps working too until you use this one. Change it under Settings → Signing in.

Or open this link to sign in with it straight away — it works even if wrong PINs have locked the account:

https://halexdias31-pixel.github.io/family/?signin=LK1

If this was not you, do nothing — your PIN has not changed, and whoever asked cannot read this email.
